title: Dataset composition and linked-group construction

conventions.fold_combination: within-seed: mean of fold AUCs; retrieval hits pooled over folds
conventions.difference: paired by seed, then mean and sample SD of the per-seed differences
conventions.ood_interval: saved 95% paired query bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 0

caption: Setting composition after exact-duplicate removal. SCOTUS sources: Oyez (O), LexisNexis (L), Wikipedia (W); -- marks an absent class. \emph{Pairs}: linked document pairs (held-out retrieval targets); \emph{Unpaired}: documents without a recorded link, used for fitting and as distractors. Linked groups, never split between training and evaluation, are single pairs in the binary settings, 2{,}784 triples (one per decision) in DE--FR--IT, and 1{,}286 pairs plus 633 triples in O--L--W (O--L 1{,}285, O--W 768, L--W 1{,}132 pairs). SCOTUS files have no case IDs: as in \citet{fan2025medium}, row $i$ of one source block is linked to row $i$ of the other for $i<1{,}024$ (780 for O--W), and deduplication breaks 7, 8 and 7 of these links. O--L--W merges the three files on (source, text) and joins links transitively (391 pairs); 4 components with two summaries of one source (16 documents) stay unpaired.
